findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Preparation - General Process, steps=[Preparation - General Process_Step 1]
findings.problem: The key starting material is recorded as bare tembotrione, which is not a reactant of the step the pathway cites; the step consumes crystal modifications II and III.
findings.quote: dass man die nach WO 00/21924 erhältliche Kristallmodifikation II und III von Tembotrione beziehungsweise Gemische davon in einem geeigneten Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst
findings.artifact_says: ksm.identifier = "tembotrione"; steps[0].reactant_names = ["tembotrione crystal modification II", "tembotrione crystal modification III"]
findings.should_be: ksm.identifier = "tembotrione crystal modification II" (the first-listed reactant of the earliest step, per A3 rule 3), keeping the existing recited_inputs_are_alternatives_not_a_single_ksm flag to carry the II-or-III alternation.

findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Preparation - General Process, steps=[Preparation - General Process_Step 2]
findings.problem: Same defect on the grinding route: the ksm is recorded as tembotrione while the step's only reactants are crystal modifications II and III.
findings.quote: Die stabile Kristallmodifikation I kann auch durch Mahlen unter hohem Druck aus den Kristallmodifikationen II und III beziehungsweise Gemischen davon erhalten werden.
findings.artifact_says: ksm.identifier = "tembotrione"; steps[0].reactant_names = ["tembotrione crystal modification II", "tembotrione crystal modification III"]

findings.problem: The patent-scope pathway asserts the route tembotrione to crystal modification I, which the patent never discloses; the disclosed and claimed process starts from a metastable modification, not from tembotrione at large.
findings.quote: a) eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione in Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst und
findings.should_be: ksm.identifier = "tembotrione crystal modification II". As written, finalise.py will bind compound_uuid to the bulk tembotrione record and the one distinction the whole patent turns on is lost silently. Both reference runs put the literal first reactant of steps[0] in ksm on every pathway without exception.

findings.problem: No pathway was emitted for the Claims section although A2 carries two terminal steps for it, Claims_Step 1 and Claims_Step 2.
findings.quote: Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man
findings.artifact_says: honest_uncertainty_flags carries "claims_8_and_9_recite_this_same_transformation_no_separate_claims_pathway_emitted" and "claim_10_recites_this_same_transformation_no_separate_claims_pathway_emitted" instead of the records
findings.should_be: Emit the section pathways for Claims_Step 1 and Claims_Step 2 as A3 rule 7 requires. Rule 8 already establishes that a duplicate step set is emitted rather than suppressed, and both reference runs (CN104292137A, CN111440099B) carry a scope=section, section_label=Claims pathway whose steps duplicate another section's. Suppressing them is a deliberate deviation that will read as a false negative in any diff.

findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone
findings.problem: The flag asserts the acetone example is not the invention's process, which the source does not support and [0024] argues against: the example is exactly the dissolve-warm-then-cooling-crystallisation variant the invention describes, and it sits under the heading Preparation of the thermodynamically stable crystal modification I.
findings.quote: Im Allgemeinen kann die Umwandlung zur Kristallmodifikation I bei vollständiger Auflösung der Kristalle der Kristallmodifikationen II und III beziehungsweise Gemischen davon bei erhöhter Temperatur durch Kühlungskristallisation zur Raumtemperatur ohne die Verwendung von Impfkristallen direkt erzielt werden.
findings.should_be: Replace with a flag that states only what is true and unstated, e.g. example_charge_modification_unstated: [0055] charges 2 g Tembotrione without saying which modification, and [0020] says such material usually crystallises as the metastable II and III. What would settle it is the modification of the 2 g charge, which the patent never gives; asserting the example is outside the invention's process is a claim the text does not make.

findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Preparation - General Process, steps=[Preparation - General Process_Step 2]
findings.problem: A stated lower bound is projected into the flat pressure field as a point value of 500.0 kPa with no marker that it is a minimum.
findings.quote: Geeigneter Druck ist ein Druck von mindestens 5 bar.
findings.artifact_says: steps[0].pressure = 500.0; conditions.pressure.type = "elevated", value_kpa = 500.0, qualitative_text preserves "mindestens 5 bar"
findings.should_be: Fix in A2, not here: conditions.pressure should carry the minimum as a bound rather than a set point, so the derived flat pressure does not read as a measured 500 kPa. The qualitative_text is correct and is the only thing that currently stops the number being misread; a consumer reading pathway steps[0].pressure alone sees a set point the patent does not state.

findings.problem: One molecule carries two different chemical_family tags across the artifact: cyclohexanedione on the three Preparation and patent pathways, triketone on the three example pathways.
findings.quote: eine in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierende Modifikation von 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione).
findings.artifact_says: pathways 0, 1 and the patent pathway carry chemical_family:cyclohexanedione; the three example pathways carry chemical_family:triketone, for the same substance
findings.should_be: Fix in A1, not here: the compound records for tembotrione and its three modifications disagree between sections (preparation-general-process.json and claims.json say cyclohexanedione, the three example files say triketone). A3's union is mechanically correct given those inputs, so the correction belongs upstream; pick one family term and use it in every section.

findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone (and the same on the Ethanol and Toluene example pathways)
findings.problem: truncated_chain is asserted on the three example pathways whose ksm is tembotrione itself, a marketed active ingredient, which is arguably the purchasable starting material the flag says was not reached.
findings.quote: Tembotrione an sich kann beispielsweise nach einem der in WO 00/21924 genannten Verfahren hergestellt werden.
findings.should_be: Keep truncated_chain on the three pathways whose ksm is a crystal modification obtainable only from WO 00/21924; consider dropping it where the ksm is tembotrione itself. The reference run CN111440099B has a pathway with ksm tembotrione and does not flag it truncated. Low confidence because the patent does say tembotrione itself is made elsewhere, so the flag is defensible on a strict reading of rule 15.

findings.record: scope=section, section_label=Preparation - General Process, steps=[Preparation - General Process_Step 1] and the patent pathway built from the same step
findings.problem: The published temperature preference ladder at [0024] does not nest, and the pathway-level flags do not say so; a consumer reading only the pathway sees a clean 0 to 80 C range.
findings.quote: Die Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I erfolgt bei Temperaturen kleiner 100°C, bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C, besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 60°C bis 80°C, ganz besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 50°C bis 80°C.
findings.artifact_says: conditions.temperature = {type: range, min_c: 0.0, max_c: 80.0}; the defect is described in steps[0].notes only
findings.should_be: Add a flag such as source_temperature_preference_ladder_does_not_nest to honest_uncertainty_flags on the two pathways built from this step. Low confidence that this belongs here: rule 15's flags are about assumptions the chain construction made, and the step notes do preserve the ladder verbatim, so this may be correctly out of A3's scope.

checks_passed.what_was_verified: The absence of pathways-provenance.json is the expected shape, not a defect. runs/CN104292137A/output/stages/A3-pathways/ and runs/CN111440099B/output/stages/A3-pathways/ each contain pathways.json and nothing else, while their A1 and A2 stage directories do carry per-section provenance sidecars. Nothing was written under runs/CN104292137A/.

The 22 top-level keys and the 73 step keys are set-identical to both reference runs. pathway_uuid is omitted, reaction_uuid is null, no id or enrichment or vector field is populated: all of feasibility_score, safety_score, green_score, cost_score, yield_score, byproduct_score, confidence_score, transformation_reaction_count, common_literature_patent_count, common_literature_journal_count, atom_mapped_rxn, atom_map_confident, template_r0/r1/r2 and hashes, canonical_rxn, reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source are null on all 6 steps, and the pathway-level min_* and all_steps_atom_map_confident are null on all 6 records. ksm.smiles, ksm.compound_uuid, product.smiles and product.compound_uuid are null throughout, so the artifact contains no structure, formula or molecular weight anywhere.

Every one of the 45 fields rule 11 requires copied verbatim was compared programmatically, field by field, between each of the 6 steps and the A2 record of the same reaction_id in output/stages/A2-reactions/. All 270 comparisons are exactly equal, including procedure_text, notes, conditions, workup, compounds and validation_flags. No step was re-worded or re-classified.

temperature_c, room_temperature, pressure, concentration, time_h, atmosphere and reactor_type were recomputed from each step's conditions object as the rule specifies and all 42 derived values match. In particular temperature_c is null on every step because every temperature is a range and value_c is null, and room_temperature is false everywhere because no conditions.temperature.type is room_temperature.

components equals reactant_names plus product_name on all 6 steps. The seed crystals of modification I on Preparation Step 1 are correctly held in compounds[] with role additive and correctly excluded from components.

All six tag lists were rebuilt independently from the step tags, the A1 compound tags of ksm and product, and the four derived categories, deduplicated in first-seen order, and all six match the artifact exactly (25, 21, 22, 22, 22, 25 tags). chain_length:1, branching:linear, convergence:linear and lcl:short are correct for one-step chains. Every tag in the artifact matches ^[a-z0-9_]+:[a-z0-9_]+$ and every enum value is inside its closed list in A2 rule 26: solvent_class protic/aprotic_polar/aqueous/hydrocarbon/halogenated/neat, catalyst_class none, workup_type crystallisation/filtration/none, purification recrystallisation/none, step_role final_step, linkage standalone, is_one_pot false. transformation:polymorph_conversion is legal because the transformation category is open-ended in A2 rule 26. All honest_uncertainty_flags are lowercase snake_case ASCII.

overall_yield_pct and overall_purity_pct are null on all six records, which is correct. The source states no yield anywhere: there is no occurrence of Ausbeute, no percent-of-theory figure, and no product mass. The only weight percentages in the document are the formulation content preferences at [0027] and [0043] and the composition limit in claim 12, none of which is a step purity. No aggregate has been computed from values the patent does not give, and nothing was assumed to be 100 percent.

There is no step arithmetic to close. The only charge stated anywhere in the document is 2 g of tembotrione at [0055], [0056] and [0057]; no product mass, no mole quantity, no equivalents and no molecular weight appears in any record. Every quantity field other than those three mass_g values is null. Step-to-step continuity does not arise: every chain is one step, so no step consumes a previous step's output. The absence of a validation_flag is correct because there is no inconsistency to flag.

precursor_step is null and linkage_confirmed is false on all 6 steps, matching the A2 records, so there is no unsubstantiated linkage_confirmed: true. I checked for a genuine link left null: [0056] produces crystal modification II and [0057] produces modification III, which is the material [0021] and claim 8 consume, so a two-step chain is chemically constructible. The patent never asserts that the example material is fed into the conversion; [0021] attributes its input to WO 00/21924. The null is therefore honest, and the artifact says so in example_not_linked_to_general_process_precursor_step_null_in_a2.

Reading the source independently, the document discloses exactly five distinct operations on matter: the solvent-mediated conversion of modifications II and III to I at [0021] to [0025], the milling conversion at [0026], and the three example crystallisations at [0055], [0056] and [0057]. Claims 8, 9 and 10 restate the first two; there are no others. [0038] to [0043] describe formulation mixing, which is not a chemical transformation, and [0058] is a storage trial. No transformation has been counted twice: the patent-scope record duplicates the Preparation Step 1 record only because A3 rule 8 requires it, and the two Preparation section records are the two genuinely different routes, which the artifact flags as such.

checks_passed.check: precision (key starting material is not a solvent)
checks_passed.what_was_verified: On the three example pathways the ksm is tembotrione, which is the 2 g solute the paragraph charges, and acetone, ethanol and toluene are carried with role solvent and are nowhere nominated as a starting material. No solvent appears in any ksm, intermediates or product field on any of the six records.

Every stated temperature was compared to its paragraph. Acetone [0055]: max_c 56.0 from 'in der Siedehitze (56°C)', min_c null because the endpoint is Raumtemperatur with no number given, correctly not flattened to a point and correctly not recorded as type room_temperature. Ethanol [0056]: 7.0 to 78.0. Toluene [0057]: 7.0 to 111.0. General process: 0.0 to 80.0 from [0021] and [0022]. The cooling rate is carried as text and no duration was computed from it, so time_h is null; the general passage's rate is transcribed without a per-hour unit because the page prints none, while the examples keep the printed 20°C/h.

Source language is German. Every solvent named at [0023] maps one for one onto the artifact's English identifiers: Methanol, Ethanol, 2-Propanol, Aceton, 2-Butanon, Wasser, Benzol, Toluol, Chlorbenzol against methanol, ethanol, 2-propanol, acetone, 2-butanone, water, benzene, toluene, chlorobenzene. Aceton is acetone and not acetonitrile, 2-Butanon is 2-butanone and not butanol, Benzol is benzene and not petrol, Toluol is toluene. No compound or reagent identifier in the artifact names something different from the German.

There is exactly one [IMAGE_EXTRACT: ...] span, at line 61, and it is a single structure with no arrow. I opened input/pages/p02.png myself. The drawn molecule is a benzene ring bearing, clockwise from the aroyl attachment: the carbonyl at C1, Cl at C2, CH2-O-CH2-CF3 at C3, SO2CH3 at C4, with C5 and C6 unsubstituted; the carbonyl joins the carbon between the two ketones of a cyclohexane-1,3-dione. The vision SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F encodes that ring system with those four substituents at exactly those positions, so no position was inferred from chemical knowledge, and the formula C17H16ClF3O6S recounts correctly from the drawing (17 C, 16 H, 6 O). No reaction scheme is drawn anywhere in this document, so the above-arrow against below-arrow reagent check and the background-scheme-annotated-as-the-invention check have nothing to fire on.

Each honest_uncertainty_flag was checked against the source. True and supported: no_synthetic_transformation_in_patent (no bond is formed or broken anywhere in the document); single_step_chain_not_a_multistep_route and truncated_chain on the Preparation and patent records; ksm_not_prepared_in_this_patent_wo_00_21924_cited_at_0020, which [0020] at line 571 supports for tembotrione and for the metastable modifications it says tembotrione crystallises as; ksm_same_substance_as_product_polymorph_conversion_only; yield_missing_step and purity_missing_terminal_step; cross_reference_unresolved, which matches the step-level validation_flags and rule 16; recited_inputs_are_alternatives_not_a_single_ksm, supported by 'Kristallmodifikation II und III ... beziehungsweise Gemische davon' at line 578; claims_8_and_9_recite_this_same_transformation and claim_10_recites_this_same_transformation, both verified against lines 801 to 810; two_alternative_routes_in_one_section_emitted_as_two_pathways; solvent_free_grinding_route_reaction_class_other_no_enum_covers_it, correct because the A2 reaction_class list has no polymorph or milling value; patent_scope_route_chosen_as_the_solvent_mediated_process_of_0021_to_0025 and grinding_route_of_0026_is_an_equally_disclosed_alternative_to_the_same_target; example_not_linked_to_general_process_precursor_step_null_in_a2; product_is_a_metastable_form_the_invention_process_consumes_not_produces, supported by [0021]. Two flags are reported as findings above: the acetone example's not_the_invention_process assertion, and truncated_chain where the ksm is tembotrione itself.

The artifact contains no em dash and no en dash. The only non-ASCII characters are the degree sign and German umlauts inside verbatim procedure_text and condition quotes, which is the authoritative source language and is permitted.
